FileStorage.// Provider: Where uploaded files (job photos, receipts, the business logo) are stored: 'Local' for a directory on disk, 'S3' for an S3 bucket. Local keeps development free of AWS credentials; a real deployment must use S3, because the container's filesystem is discarded on every rebuild.
FileStorage.// RootPath: Local provider only — directory for stored files, relative to the content root.

S3.// BucketName: S3 provider only — required, startup fails without it. Production bucket is mobmek-uploads-649058763120 (see infrastructure/docs/phase-1-plan.md).
S3.// Region: S3 provider only — leave blank on EC2 to use the instance's own region; set it for off-instance access.

PublicSite.// AllowedOrigins: Origins allowed to call the anonymous booking endpoints. Set to the real marketing-site origin(s) in production; no wildcards, these endpoints write to the calendar.
